title: NASA Dart: second pair of edge-to-centre folds (prefix)
instruction: The rectangle has already completed all three instruction rows on page 1 (PDF page19): lengthwise fold, unfold, and both upper corners folded to the centre. On page 2 (PDF page20), complete ONLY the FIRST instruction row, bringing both new sloping upper edges to the centre. Stop at the result of that row, before the next row tells you to fold the whole packet in half, and call finish. This is a scoped intermediate-state task, not the complete airplane. The paper keeps the source 8.5:11 aspect but is scaled to 15 cm width. Blue is the original front and cream the original back.
source_note: NASA Wingin It, Dart, PDF pages19-20. No printed step numbers: row labels are local references. Original source photographs are local cache only. The source was inspected during development, not a held-out source.
